candidates.title: Hourly output peaks 13:10 at 266 pcs
candidates.rationale: Trend over shift-day 09:20–19:20 using 時間当 (hourly good qty); peak 13:10 = 266, the day max, with a dip at 09:20 (34) and 14:10 (160).

candidates.title: New builds split: FD32 dominates at 13:10 (171 pcs)
candidates.rationale: Split comparison on shared X using FD32[8] and FD31[9] (new builds per model); FD32[8] peaks at 171 in 13:10 while FD31[9] peaks at 95 in the same slot. FD03[7] and all rework columns are constant 0 and omitted.

candidates.title: Hourly production details
candidates.rationale: Exact values for 時間当, 累計, new builds, and net seconds; constant columns (目標数, FD03[7], rework) excluded from chart but noted in rationale.

questions.q: Why does output drop from 170 pcs at 11:20 to 160 pcs at 14:10 after the 266 pcs peak at 13:10?
questions.why: Mid-shift dip pattern unclosable from this set — needs downtime or break cause.
